equation_summary: LogLinearMamba2 (fla log_linear_attn) keeps a HIERARCHICAL set of level states kv_0..kv_L, one per dyadic level. The effective transition matrix is H = sum_level A ∘ mask_level where A=exp(segsum(g)) is the cumulative decay and mask_level selects dyadic sub-blocks (naive.py:44-51). Output = (H ∘ (q k^T-decay)) contracted with v. In the chunked kernel (chunk.py), each level state kv_l is a [K,V] matrix that is decayed by exp(g_last) each chunk and accumulated via dot(k,v); a carry step (chunk.py:341-386) propagates a completed lower level into the next higher level (kv_{l+1} += kv_l; kv_l=0) at dyadic boundaries, implementing hierarchical pooling. Partial-chunk streaming is handled via offsets and copy_input/copy_last_chunk kernels.
state_shape: hierarchical set of [K,V] level states kv_0..kv_L (one per dyadic level), plus offsets and a carried last partial chunk (q/k/v/g/level_scales_prev)
gate_scope: channel (per-channel decay g) + dyadic level structure

CONFIRM ledger blocker `Partial-chunk streaming and source layer, not only aligned chunks` — the kernel explicitly handles partial chunks via offsets, copy_input_kernel and copy_last_chunk_kernel (chunk.py:434-608, 546-608), and only applies the state update when the last chunk is full (chunk.py:285-287).

CONFIRM task hypothesis: this shares axis A4 (hierarchical chunks) with 009. The dyadic level state and the level-carry (kv_{l+1}+=kv_l at boundaries) is exactly the A4 hierarchical-chunk property; an additive-K2 single-state substitution is invalid.
axis: A4 hierarchical chunks (dyadic level state with boundary carry)
direction_justification: LogLinearMamba2 is a hierarchical dyadic level state with level-carry at boundaries and explicit partial-chunk streaming — the A4 hierarchical-chunks property shared with 009 Log-linear attention, which cannot be reduced to a single additive K2 state.
